steps: Always there, just behind me—the same scent, unchanged.
As Shia promised, the seafood dinner is a feast.
I'm so full ... I can barely walk...
As long as you enjoyed it, that's the important thing. Next time, I'll take you to another place♪
We step out of the restaurant to find the sky completely dark.
That wraps up today's "seaside adventure." I hope you had a good time, Boss.
Yeah! Definitely! We bought swimsuits today and didn't even get to use them.
If our seaside adventure ends here... I'll be regretting it for the rest of my life!
Ah—sorry, sorry...! My mind's been all over the place—I completely forgot...!
But the beach after dark... ==W==Well, it's a bit dangerous. I wouldn't really recommend going for a swim...
Drat... At this rate, my plan to cheer her up is gonna go down the drain...
Maybe we can do that next time—
A-actually... I've always been kind of interested in surfing. I've wanted to try it for a while now...
Right. Even though it's good to have something to look forward to next time, it's better if we can make today the most unforgettable moment.
It's so quiet... Completely different from the beach during the day.
The darkness conceals the sea's dangers—unlike during the day, you can't see the currents.==W== That's why both tourists and locals avoid the beach at night.
But as long as you're here, it should be okay, right?
Yeah. Once we're in the water, don't leave my side, okay?
If you're scared, you can hold on to me tight... That'll put my mind at ease as well♪
Setting aside the whole "holding tight" part... I'll do my best to stay by your side.
Surfing at night, and with Shia no less... I'm already starting to get nervous...
Wa-wait... Please, don't talk to me right now!
I can barely keep my balance... I don't even have time to think about fun or whatever... Ahhh!
Hehe, really? Then—how about making the splash even bigger? Oh, you agreed, no take-backs.
I agreed to no such thing!!!
Boss, how was your first time surfing? Pretty fun, right?
To be honest, I was a bit scared at first...==W== But once I got used to it, it actually felt really freeing. Such a rush!
I was supposed to be the one cheering Shia up. Instead I got hooked on surfing...
It's really impressive that you can keep your balance on your first try. Boss, you've definitely got a knack for this.
Nah, it's just that I have a good teacher.
Thank you so much, Shia. I have had a wonderful day.
It's me who should be thanking you.
I was hoping to show you around properly, but it turned out completely different from what I imagined.
You were with me the whole time, and yet ... I still let myself get all caught up in feeling down.
In the end, you're the one who cheered me up and helped me feel better. So really, I should be the one thanking you♪
Heh, because you suddenly want to go surfing.
When I'm feeling down, I often go surfing.
You remembered I said that, didn't you?
Even though I wasn't exactly subtle about it, it's still kind of embarrassing to be seen through...
Anyway, I just didn't want to see you with that lonely look on your face...
If you're not happy, Shia, then we can't make today the best day in our memory.
I just wanted to create a good memory for myself. That's why I dragged you into surfing with me... Nothing more.
But I didn't want you to just put on a happy face for me.
It's completely normal to feel a sense of loss when something familiar suddenly disappears.
To me, scents are like lighthouses by the sea. They mark all my memories.
But today... Even though the streets looked familiar, their scent felt completely foreign.
I know the world is always changing, just like new waves always wash over the old ones. ==W==But ... I still... I still have a hard time getting used to it.
If the lighthouse light goes out and the sea is completely dark... Where will I drift to?
Ah...==W== Eh?==W== Eh—?==W== Why are you==W== suddenly…?!
Would doing this make you feel better?
Yeah…==W== I like being held tightly like this.==W== It's so reassuring.==W== Though you gave me a little start==W== when you suddenly came close…
Is it that you still remember …==W== what I told you==W== about hugging granny when I was a kid?
That’s also a part of today’s memories, right?
Hehe,==W== I see.==W== You really are==W== very gentle.
Oh,==W== by the way...==W== When you held me just now,==W== I suddenly realized something.
All day long,==W== I've felt lonely,==W== as if the whole world had left me behind…==W== That's a feeling==W== engraved==W== so deeply in my heart…
But==W== when I'm with you,==W== I …==W== feel truly happy.==W== That much==W== I’m sure of.
Mm.==W== Because,==W== in all those foreign scents,==W== there's always one==W== that's most familiar to me.==W== And ...==W== that scent==W== has been by my side all along.
Hehe,==W== do you understand==W== what that is?
Speaking of which, you smelled my scent when we first met...
Hehe…==W== Back then==W== I didn’t think that much...==W== Anyway,==W== in the days to come,==W== everything around me==W== will surely==W== continue to change.
But…==W== Just by knowing==W== that one scent==W== will never change,==W== I feel like I'm no longer afraid.==W== Thank you,==W== ==SEX7== bunny♪
That night, I talked with Shia until the early hours before heading home.
Today was such a wonderful day♪
It's just that there were some things I couldn't bring myself to say.
Maybe even my scent has changed.
Ah... I already smell like Boss now...
